## [1.5.0](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/compare/v1.4.1...v1.5.0) (2026-09-19)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **flags:** purge obsolete 3024 and legacy memory flags, align 3999 to official dump ([e729331](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/e72933185457d609d3ca07ab8fba03380db98d26))
* **flags:** purge truncated 4-digit flags, use verified 8-digit keys, and ensure synchronous persistence ([f6c0d66](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/f6c0d666be8572a2959ee3dcd1ec7440a93da6c9))
* **flags:** sync recipe toggle state bidirectionally with Curated Flags and write zero-values on disable ([97b0788](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/97b0788457f2a97b8aea116e861d90b659d4fbe6))
* **photos:** align story cutouts, system fonts, OneGoogle avatar, and seed data ([4e294c2](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/4e294c28fc8dd65e8830f60a3ffff1c49d00cf17))
* **photos:** resolve Locked Folder cloud backup on mod package name ([02caf09](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/02caf093742bc5b273fc0a178163e05139471c6c))
* **ui:** dynamic flag count in reset menu, now shows correct 29 instead of stale 26 ([0821a8a](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/0821a8a1bbd32bf982c0186af424f749ed583e9e))

### ✨ New Features

* **flags:** add 45709528 (Enhanced Pixel Processing) to curated flags, updating total to 25 ([0e6466f](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/0e6466f32af3e38ca6e8f9d9fa99ae14f6f95fb4))
* **flags:** add curated flags table and refine patch definitions ([8c0e159](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/8c0e1599ae8dea90e5c624f2839eabdde83cf72b))

patches.name: Account avatar
patches.description: Loads and displays account profile avatars across the top toolbar, Bento menu, and account switcher.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Renames the package to app.morphe.android.apps.photos to allow non-root installation alongside pre-installed Google Photos. Deselect this if Google Photos is not installed as a system app on your device to keep the original package name.

options.description: The name of the package to rename the app to.

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: [Experimental] Disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to the maximum allowed. This patch may cause unexpected issues with some apps and does not work if the app is installed by root mounting

patches.name: Enable DCIM folders backup control
patches.description: Disables always on backup for the Camera and other DCIM folders, allowing you to control backup for each folder individually. This will make the app default to having no folders backed up.

patches.name: Enable Phenotype flag manager
patches.description: Enables an in-app flag manager in Photos Settings to toggle curated experimental UI redesigns, video editor tools, and feature flags.

patches.name: Fix memory style font loading
patches.description: Redirects Skottie animation font loading to system fonts for mod package compatibility, fixing blank text and cutout crashes in Memories.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows the app to work without root by using a different package name when patched using a GmsCore instead of Google Play Services.

patches.name: Model Readiness Gates
patches.description: Bypasses the 0MB Mobile Data Download check for AI models and reports them as loaded.

patches.name: Spoof features
patches.description: Spoofs the device to enable Google Pixel exclusive features, including unlimited storage.

## [1.15.0](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/compare/v1.14.4...v1.15.0) (2026-10-15)

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* **Google Photos:** Add support for v7.97.0.997578476 ([ad8039a](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/ad8039a2630226babc9f5e5e2fa0971acfc35dd2))

### ✨ New Features

* **Google Photos - Toolkit:** Introduce Morphe Toolkit in Photos Settings for batch cloud trash, restore, archive, personal/shared album management, and DCIM export ([04d6868](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/04d68687248536b0136fb1a5ce13b9aa34613170))
* **Google Photos - Toolkit:** Photo inspector & comparison modal with difference hash (dHash) visual similarity clustering ([50931df](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/50931df181f77e99239d95f763905367e53df041))
* **Google Photos - Toolkit:** Direct biometric unlock for Locked Folder with local-vs-cloud storage backup status notices ([899da3e](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/899da3eccfb41c6690829409288b99babf4f620d))
* **Google Photos - Diagnostics:** In-app universal diagnostic log viewer with severity/scope filters, noise suppression, and one-tap GitHub report export ([85197e9](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/85197e9af6911f6750ebb9b0299af2e47d590b12))
* **Google Photos - Flags:** Add `components` option to choose between Flag Manager, Morphe Toolkit, or both ([19f0a62](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/19f0a622192b40c5d76c834cb43bb86a74918aec))
* **Google Photos - UI:** Unify Material 3 styling, search inputs, dialog geometries, and add a dedicated terminal console vector icon ([ea345e1](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/ea345e128ae34cbe90bc2614b7e1ce8e11a684b7), [14652a8](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/14652a8c3d0f046b043c9ba81b7e289bf592c3a7))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Google Photos - Patches:** Consolidate patch registry into 8 core patches and integrate Play Store update blocker directly into `Official package name` ([5a59076](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/5a590760f3817f7d1b3294c7b88ec7b09c6ae983))
* **Google Photos - UI:** Dynamically adapt floating pill launchers to system navigation bar and gesture insets ([c11bb7c](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/c11bb7c4ad11c3a1bc7b561c72369b9f227fdaa9))
* **Google Photos - Gms:** Automatically rename all package and component permissions during package name changes ([cc4ba67](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/cc4ba676334e4b8d6ce4707bcfdfaa7a95fca51f))
* **Google Photos - Flags:** Remove obsolete and dead legacy flags purged by upstream Google servers ([738c08b](https://github.com/Akash-Sriram/morphe-google-photos/commit/738c08b23073b58cc4ab8450cf4bdac218399f7b))
